item.title: Behaviour Interactive Addresses Dead by Daylight Controversy
item.description: Behaviour Interactive is under fire for supporting VTuber TheBurntPeanut following a Halloween stream. Many community members dislike the controversial streamer due to repeated accusations of offensive behavior, alleged viewbotting, and the use of racial and homophobic slurs. This caused dozens of players to uninstall Dead by Daylight and voice their discontent on social media. Behaviour Interactive is doing damage control and has issued a statement addressing the matter.

item.title: Dragon Ball Manga Return Hopes Officially Dashed by Shueisha
item.description: It's almost time for Jump Festa, the annual event where Japanese publisher Shueisha showcases its most important manga and gives fans exciting updates for the future. Except that this year, Shueisha's most famous property, Dragon Ball , will barely be featured at Jump Festa. Fans speculate that the franchise's complicated status could be the reason, and that surprising changes could be on the horizon.

item.title: 'Avatar: Seven Havens' Season 2 Could Return to 'The Last Airbender’s Most Iconic Location
item.description: Ba Sing Se once survived a century-long war by pretending the war didn’t exist at all, only to get taken over by the Fire Nation during Avatar: The Last Airbender . Despite ongoing political turmoil extending through The Legend of Korra ’s era, the Earth Kingdom’s former capital persisted — and one version of it even survived the Cataclysm. Avatar: Seven Havens revealed the existence of a Haven called New Ba Sing Se during season 1, offering a glimpse of a society still clinging to old traditions while its people go hungry. And based on one specific detail from the season finale, there’s a very good reason to suspect we'll get to see the city of New Ba Sing Se firsthand in season 2.

item.title: 'The Mandalorian' Meets 'Avatar' in Netflix's New Sci-Fi Western Masterpiece
item.description: Created by LeSean Thomas and Studio Mir, who both worked on The Legend of Korra , Bass X Machina is a reimagining of the story of Bass Reeves (Brian Tyree Henry), an escaped slave who worked in Indian Territory as a deputy U.S. Marshal. Reeves’ real life was extraordinary, and is said to have inspired the character of the Lone Ranger, but Bass X Machina also gives him a cybernetic arm that shoots magic bullets. The criminals he fights get even bigger upgrades, and the stakes can at times escalate to truly ludicrous levels. Henry does an especially great job expressing exasperation as Bass faces plenty of absurd foes, like an outlaw in a rampaging bull mech that requires complex cooperation to take down.

item.title: Zelda Ocarina of Time release time in your time zone
item.description: The Zelda Ocarina of Time remake release time is just around the corner, as Nintendo introduces a new generation to one of its classic games. Unlike the 3DS port from 2011, Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 includes a massive visual overhaul, along with several quality-of-life features that weren't present in the original Nintendo 64 release. Pre-orders are still open at some retailers if you're hoping to snag a special bonus, though US-based folks only get one bonus to choose from.

item.title: 20 Years Later, Uncle Iroh's Wisest 'Avatar: The Last Airbender Quote' Is Still Undefeated
item.description: Avatar: The Last Airbender has more than its fair share of heartfelt moments and poignant lines. Whether it’s Aang reassuring a downtrodden Toph in the vast loneliness of the desert, or Ursa’s parting words to her son Zuko before disappearing in the middle of the night, the series can be surprisingly deep for what some might (incorrectly) consider a mere children’s show. No character embodies that richness and depth more than Uncle Iroh, who begins as Zuko's wise mentor and becomes so much more. Time and again, Iroh sits at the center of The Last Airbender 's most moving moments, offering quiet wisdom just when it's needed most.

item.title: New Star Wars Book Reveals the Surprising '90s Inspiration for an Iconic New Character
item.description: After years on Disney Plus, Din Djarin (Pedro Pascal) and his surrogate Jedi son, Grogu, made their big-screen debut in The Mandalorian and Grogu earlier this year. Now, The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu by Phillip Szostak is set to hit shelves this week, offering a behind-the-scenes look at the film’s production from start to finish.

item.title: World of Warcraft Forever release time in your time zone
item.description: The release of World of Warcraft: Forever brings a third — or, depending on how you count them, a sixth or seventh — way to play World of Warcraft to everyone with a WoW subscription. Joining the modern game and the Classic servers, Forever is based on WoW as it was at launch in 2004, but with new content, rebalanced classes, graphical enhancements, and lots of modernization.

item.title: Nintendo Officially Comments on Zelda Remake's Divisive Graphics
item.description: Nintendo 's upcoming remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time looks drastically different from the Nintendo 64 original. That's understandable, given the nearly 28 years that have passed since the first 3D Zelda debuted. Beyond the graphical advancements, however, the Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time makes some bold character design choices, some of which have divided longtime Zelda fans .
